Place: a sunlit rural earthware museum courtyard with a large tilted terracotta echo jar and stone seating, dry grasses beyond the low wall.
Activity: she listens to the jar resonate after tapping its rim; a quiet playful moment inspired by her sensitive elephant hearing, no tools or repair work.
Outfit: a coral-pink fitted asymmetric fan-pleated bandeau top, held securely by a single broad diagonal shoulder band and a small opaque curved peplum at one hip, paired with high-waisted charcoal culotte shorts with an offset scalloped waistband; bare shoulder and midriff, opaque and securely covered chest and pelvis. This original clothing construction is absent from the catalog.
Pose and arms: seated sideways on a stone bench, torso turned gently toward the viewer; her right upper arm angles down from her shoulder, forearm extended and fingertips resting lightly on the near rim of the jar; her left forearm rests across her lap, left palm flat on the shorts, each hand has one job. Both knees point diagonally forward with feet on dry ground.
Composition: vertical 2:3, knees-up framing at face-height, face visible in front three-quarter view; both shoulders and both complete hands visible. Warm morning light and soft leaf shadows.
10:
Place: a bright open-air botanical water garden during a costume performance rehearsal, with a broad raised lily sculpture beside a low dry stone stage, fountain spray far behind.
Activity and situation: a sudden broad leaf-shaped stage canopy unfurls above her; she raises her right arm to steady its rim, naturally opening her pose and showing her side waist and upper back. Her costume stays securely fitted with no wardrobe failure and no transparency. The moment is neither wet clothing, wind-blown clothes, partly unfastened clothes nor a slipped shoulder strap.
Outfit: an original adult botanical stage-performer costume: an opaque orchid-purple fitted petal-lattice halter bodice with a smooth fully covered bust and a narrow vertical side-waist cutout, plus an asymmetric cream split-petal bustle skort with opaque fitted shorts beneath and tiny copper leaf fasteners; bare shoulders, midriff and thighs, chest and pelvis securely covered. This structural petal bustle skort and lattice halter combination is absent from the catalog.
Pose and arms: standing in a shallow side lunge with both feet on the dry stage, body at a gentle front three-quarter angle; her right upper arm rises openly from its own shoulder and right hand steadies the canopy rim above shoulder level, her left arm extends down in front of her hip with left hand holding the short rolled rehearsal ribbon. Each arm and hand is separately visible and has one job.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full body with head and both feet inside the frame, camera at face height, clear face and visible eyes looking at the opening canopy; daylight and soft reflections from the garden water.
